config.label: Engines to enable, comma-separated
config.description: Engines to enable, comma-separated. Only the listed engines get their tools registered. Example: mysql,redis,kafka

config.label: Set to true to hide every write tool and restrict *_execute_query to SELECT-style statements
config.description: Set to true to hide every write tool and restrict *_execute_query to SELECT-style statements. Recommended when pointing at production.

config.label: MySQL connection string(s), semicolon-separated for multiple instances
config.description: MySQL connection string(s), semicolon-separated for multiple instances. Format: mysql://<user>:<password>@<host>:3306/<database>?alias=dev&default=true — alias is required.

config.label: PostgreSQL connection string(s), semicolon-separated
config.description: PostgreSQL connection string(s), semicolon-separated. Format: postgresql://<user>:<password>@<host>:5432/<database>?alias=dev&ssl=true — alias is required.

config.label: Redshift connection string(s), semicolon-separated
config.description: Redshift connection string(s), semicolon-separated. Format: redshift://<user>:<password>@<host>:5439/<database>?alias=dev&ssl=true — alias is required.

config.label: MongoDB connection string(s), semicolon-separated
config.description: MongoDB connection string(s), semicolon-separated. Format: mongodb://<user>:<password>@<host>:27017/<database>?alias=dev — alias is required.

config.label: Redis connection string(s), semicolon-separated
config.description: Redis connection string(s), semicolon-separated. Format: redis://:<password>@<host>:6379/0?alias=dev — leave the password empty for a no-auth instance. alias is required.

config.label: Elasticsearch connection string(s), semicolon-separated
config.description: Elasticsearch connection string(s), semicolon-separated. Format: elasticsearch://<user>:<password>@<host>:9200?alias=dev, or http(s)://<host>:9200?alias=dev for no auth. alias is required.

config.label: Kafka connection string(s), semicolon-separated
config.description: Kafka connection string(s), semicolon-separated. Format: kafka://<user>:<password>@<broker1>:9092,<broker2>:9092?alias=dev&mechanism=plain — alias is required.

config.label: AWS region for DynamoDB
config.description: AWS region for DynamoDB. DynamoDB is configured with discrete variables instead of a connection string.

config.label: AWS access key ID for DynamoDB
config.description: AWS access key ID for DynamoDB.

config.label: AWS secret access key for DynamoDB
config.description: AWS secret access key for DynamoDB.
